chunks: We made an appointment of thirty nights with Moses, and We completed them with ten more, so the term set by his Lord was completed in forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron: 'Take my place among my people, and reform [them], and do not follow the way of the corrupters.'

key_terms.اخْلُفْنِي: Take my place / deputize for me
key_terms.مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ: The appointed term/time set by God

ai.seo_question: What was the duration of Moses' appointment with God and who did he appoint as his deputy?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the completion of the forty-night period of divine communion, a timeframe often linked to the forty-day duration of the Israelites' wandering in Shia exegetical traditions. It underscores the virtue of Aaron (AS) as a righteous deputy (Khalifah) who maintained stability during Moses' absence, serving as a model for leadership and continuity in the absence of the primary authority.
